title: Light Ukrainian Olives Tagine
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring black olives and a hint of mustard. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pitted black olives, white wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced slightly, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the olives hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired. Offer crusty bread and lemon wedges on the side, if desired.
Cook's note: If using a clay or ceramic tagine, make sure to preheat it in the oven before adding the ingredients.
If using a stovetop, reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
If using a pressure cooker, cook for 10 minutes.
If using an Instant Pot, cook for 5 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally before serving.
